messages:
support_erin: FYI Acme (acme-1001) reporting a p99 spike and intermittent 500s since ~03:10 UTC. They say latency jumps to 300-600ms on small prompts. Escalating to eng-sre.

mike_sre: Thanks Erin — looking. Any config changes deployed around 03:00-03:10?

infra_bot: deploy: config-update continuous-batcher hold_window_ms from 20 -> 6 by rachel_sre at 2026-02-14T03:04:58Z :white_check_mark:

rachel_sre: yup that was my change — reducing hold to shave avg latency. Rolling back if it's causing regressions.

mike_sre: I pulled traces for acme-1001. A lot of requests are waiting on the batch hold, then getting popped into tiny batches; some get additional delay due to downstream auth retries. Quick qstat dump:
```
queue: qid=237 active=12 head_wait_ms=196 tail_wait_ms=0 avg_hold=18.7
pending: 37
coalesce: continuous
```

ops_jordan: Also seeing auth refresh churn from that tenant around the same time — their client is hitting 401 then retrying, which interacts badly with tiny batches. Snippet from logs:
```
ERROR request_id=abcd123 auth=401 retry=1 path=/v1/generate
WARN rate_limiter_drop tenant=acme-1001 burst=1.2
```

mike_sre: Working hypothesis: lowering hold_window reduces average latency for steady traffic but for microbursts + occasional auth retries it increases frequency of underfilled batches getting stuck / retried -> p99 tail increases. Essentially more jitter, fewer coalesced batches.

rachel_sre: Repro I'm running locally: 200 qps of small prompts (avg 12 tokens) with auth failure injection (1% 401) for 5m. Script: 
```
# spawn clients
wrk -t10 -c200 -d300s -s small_prompts.lua --rate 200\n# inject failures via env
export AUTH_FAIL_RATE=0.01\n```

mike_sre: Proposed mitigation (hotfix): 1) revert hold_window to 20ms for affected pool 2) set min_batch_size=2 to avoid singleton dispatches 3) enable short token-refresh cache (30s) to reduce retry storms 4) monitor p95/p99 for 30m and rollback if needed.

rachel_sre: Applying hotfix to pool acme-pool now.

deploybot: patch: update continuous-batcher config for pool=acme-pool {"hold_window_ms":20,"min_batch_size":2} by rachel_sre
status: success

infra_bot: metric snapshot (pre -> post) p99 latency: 420ms -> 98ms, p95: 112ms -> 48ms. Rolling averages show stabilization :tada:

support_erin: Passing update to customer: explained root cause (hold_window too aggressive + auth retry amplification), actions taken, and monitoring plan. Customer happy for now. :thumbsup:

ops_jordan: Follow-up: will add an e2e gating test that simulates auth-refresh jitter + tiny-prompt workload. Filing OPS-1229 with repro script and thresholds.

mike_sre: We'll keep thread open until OPS-1229 complete and we have 24h of stable metrics. If we see recurrence we can try adaptive-grace-window or dynamic min_batch sizing.

rachel_sre: noted. thanks all for fast turnaround.

support_erin: Closing customer loop. Reopen if we see anything else. :pray:
